metadata.description: PIM for Groups policies of a new incident leads group, applied in the first run although the template declares no eligibility or assignment for the group. PIM onboards a group only on its first eligibility or assignment, and Graph lists no policy for the group before that, so both policies opt in to onboarding: they name an existing onboarding account (a disabled user or a service principal) for a temporary member eligibility of one hour. The first policy requests the eligibility, waits for Graph to list the group's policy, removes the eligibility and applies its rules; the second finds the group onboarded and only applies its rules. What-if shows the onboarding in the policy rows ('group not onboarded: a temporary eligibility for ... will onboard it, then be removed') and writes nothing. Needs Microsoft Entra ID P2 (or ID Governance) and a Privileged Role Administrator (the policies) who is also an Identity Governance Administrator, Groups Administrator, User Administrator or Directory Writers (the onboarding eligibility: the group is not role-assignable) (or RoleManagementPolicy.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup and PrivilegedEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup); see docs/pim.md and docs/permissions.md.

Object id of the account made eligible (member, one hour) to onboard the group, then removed again: a disabled user or a service principal that the group's default PIM policy allows to be made eligible.
